task_title: Move floor-specific systems into scenario pipeline slots

plan_review.notes: Alt A: bootstrap-owned floor registry — rejected because it creates a second per-floor registry and keeps executable ownership outside the existing scenario seam. Alt B: generic ordered contributor descriptors — rejected as unnecessary extensibility and weaker named ordering contracts for three known seams. Resolutions: add scenarioDefinitions.ts as an orphan-system wiring site plus guard coverage; define exactly-once as canonical preSystems membership and retain floor2ObjectiveTick victory evaluation; import getScenarioDefinition directly; table-test shared anchors and all configured entries exactly once with foreign entries absent; scope the ADR to pipeline imports only.
